answer: A jade token bound to one verified hardware key can anchor each agent's identity: to forge a new identity, an attacker must buy a fresh attested device and stake a deposit that is slashed on fraud, so each fake costs real money instead of a free API call. Reputation then grows slowly like grass on a knoll — new identities start with near-zero trust and limited quotas, so a Sybil swarm cannot flood the market before the cost of cloning outweighs any gain.
